name: Miwa Tsubaki
source: [url=/c305]Kyousuke's[/url] class representative, an innocently naive girl who puts others before herself. She writes about her life in the diary she always carries around. She lives with her family, consisting of four younger siblings and her parents in the Eastern District, a rural part of the city.
